# Event

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Something that happened.

## Scope note

Top concept for the Event hierarchy; narrower concepts partition by originator (UserEvent, AgentEvent, DeviceEvent, AppEvent, ToolEvent, ServiceEvent) and by domain (HealthEvent, MealEvent, NoteEvent, ScriptEvent, ActivityEvent).
